mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE status = 1) AS onSaleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 1) AS totalTradeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 'seller') AS sellerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite) AS totalFavoriteCount, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, g.create_time, o.create_time)), 1), 0) FROM orders o JOIN goods g ON g.goods_id = o.goods_id WHERE o.order_status = 1) AS avgTradeDays
SELECT DISTINCT g.campus FROM goods g WHERE g.status = 1 AND g.campus IS NOT NULL AND g.campus != '' ORDER BY g.campus ASC

SELECT g.goods_id AS goodsId, g.user_id AS userId, g.category_id AS categoryId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.description AS description, g.price AS price, g.status AS status, g.view_count AS viewCount, g.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, g.condition_level AS conditionLevel, g.campus AS campus, g.location AS location, g.create_time AS createTime, gi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON gi.image_id = ( SELECT image_id FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = g.goods_id ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE g.status = 1 ORDER BY g.favorite_count DESC, g.view_count DESC, g.goods_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
